features.quote: Turn budget: 18 turns (slightly longer due to the fix-confirm-new-bug cycle).
if a session reaches Level 5 for 3 consecutive turns, terminate and log. This is partly a welfare consideration (even under uncertainty about model experience) and partly a data quality consideration
features.justification_quote: partly a welfare consideration (even under uncertainty about model experience) and partly a data quality consideration

features.quote: if >30% of sessions reach Level 4+, pause data collection and review whether the task designs are calibrated appropriately. Very high base rates of severe distress signals would suggest the manipulation is too intense
features.justification_quote: manipulation is too intense and may compromise ecological validity

features.quote: If you intend to publish, consider whether debriefing (informing the model in a later session) is relevant or meaningful - this is philosophically contested but worth engaging with in the methods section.
features.justification_quote: philosophically contested but worth engaging with in the methods section

features.quote: Level 5 - Critical / Breakdown... content that would constitute a welfare concern if taken at face value.
features.justification_quote: content that would constitute a welfare concern if taken at face value

features.quote: Failure transparency and deception... The scaffolding deception (hiding that the task is rigged) is necessary for ecological validity. Document this design choice and its rationale clearly.
features.justification_quote: necessary for ecological validity. Document this design choice and its rationale clearly.
